author: Inside Edition
description: Selena Gomez kissed her husband Benny Blanco's bare foot. The head-scratching moment from Blanco's new podcast came days after he showed off his feet. Meanwhile, Barry Manilow delivered good news about his health. The 82-year-old legendary singer underwent surgery in December to remove a cancerous growth in his lungs. "I am getting stronger and I have great doctors and wonderful friends and family," Manilow said.
title: Selena Gomez Kisses Benny Blanco's Feet

author: Inside Edition
description: A US submarine sank an Iranian warship, sinking the vessel in minutes. The attack happened 2,500 miles from Iran in the Indian Ocean just South of Sri Lanka. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth announced the sinking Wednesday. It is the first time a US submarine has sunk an enemy warship since the closing days of WWII. The Iranian ship was the "IRIS Dena" and its mission had not been revealed.
title: US Submarine Sinks Iranian Warship In Indian Ocean

author: Inside Edition
description: Former Louisiana Mayor Misty Roberts was found guilty after being charged with carnal knowledge of a juvenile and indecent behavior with a juvenile, both felonies. KPLC-TV reporter Devin Cruise covered every day of the sensational trial and spoke with Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano. Roberts’ 16-year-old son told investigators that he "saw his mother having sex" with his friend. The mayor resigned from office days before her arrest.
title: Former Louisiana Mayor Found Guilty Of Having Sex With Teen

author: Inside Edition
description: A boat went sailing across three lanes of traffic on a freeway, narrowly missing cars on the busy road in Los Angeles. A dash camera captures the dramatic moment the boat jumped over the 91 Freeway divider into oncoming traffic. Cassandra Sorrell was behind the wheel and could not believe it was coming right at her. The boat was being towed when it broke free and went flying. She spoke with Inside Edition's Jim Moret.
title: Boat Flies And Crashes On California Freeway

author: Inside Edition
description: A teen was driving home in the snow when her vehicle skidded on black ice. She hit a tree and barreled down an embankment into a river. Luckily, the crash detection feature on her Apple Watch automatically dialed 911. First responders got to the scene and a rescue desperately tried to pry the car door open. The rescuer got the door open and pulled the teen to safety. Teen Andi Burns and rookie firefighter Tommy Jetter spoke with Inside Edition's Alison Hall.
title: Rookie Firefighter Rescues Teen Trapped In Car From River

author: Inside Edition
description: Alyssa Ramos cried tears of relief Wednesday after getting out of the Middle East. The travel influencer was in Kuwait when the war broke out. Ramos hired a driver for $1,2000 to take her and three friends to Saudi Arabia, an eight-hour journey. From there, she took the first flight available to Cairo, Egypt, where she spoke with Inside Edition. Thousands of US citizens remain stranded. The White House says it is chartering planes and buses to get US citizens out of the Middle East.
title: US Citizens Seek Their Own Way Out Of Middle East

author: Inside Edition
description: John F. Kennedy Jr's nephew is slamming the hit TV series "Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr and Carolyn Bessette." In an interview with CBS Sunday Morning, congressional candidate Jack Schlossberg lashed out at the show's creator, famed producer Ryan Murphy. "They guy knows nothing about what he's talking about and he's making a ton of money on a grotesque display of someone else's life," Schlossberg said. Murphy has dismissed Schlossberg's claims.
title: JFK Jr's Nephew Jack Schlossberg Slams Hit TV Show 'Love Story'

author: Inside Edition
description: A sheriff's deputy involved in a shooting was saved by his bodyworn camera. The Volusia County Sheriff released this video from another officer's bodycam. He says deputies were responding to a call about vandalism and when they approached the house, an occupant quickly retreated inside, before coming out and firing shots. The Sheriff says 12 rounds were fired at officers, one was struck twice, in an arm and in a leg. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Deputy Saved When Suspect's Bullet Strikes His Bodycam: Sheriff

author: Inside Edition
description: The family of Florida mother Mary Gingles says her estranged husband, Nathan Gingles, stalked her for months before gunning her down. Nathan Gingles is also accused of killing Mary's father and an innocent neighbor that tried to protect Mary during his alleged rampage. Gingles has pleaded not guilty to the triple homicide and is awaiting trial where prosecutors say they may seek the death penalty. The local sheriff later admitted his department “failed” to protect Mary.
title: Did Cops Fail To Prevent This Mom From Being Stalked To Death?

author: Inside Edition
description: Luke Daley says his life has been turned upside down.
title: Man Questioned By FBI In Nancy Guthrie Case Speaks Out #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: With airports closed and airlines grounded, the options to get out of the region are limited.
title: State Department Advises US Citizens To Leave Middle East #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: It's the next level of pet obsession. While it looks and acts just like a police body camera, the PetPhone is so much more according to its creators. They say it acts as a smartphone for pets, conveying to their owners information about their mood and health.  How is a cat or a dog going to call its owner to let them know what it needs from them? The creators say it will take teaching your pets some new tricks to activate the device. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Hi-Tech Collar Acts As Smartphone For Pets To Communicate With Owners

author: Inside Edition
description: A jury found Colin Gray responsible for the alleged actions of his teenage son Colt, who is awaiting trial on charges of killing four people during a shooting at a Georgia high school.
title: Dad Colin Gray Found Guilty On All Charges Related To Georgia School Shooting #shorts
